verbs.name: assets.generate
verbs.description: Queue image/video generation through the USER'S OWN agent CLI and import it as a project asset — NO model is hosted (the Openverse philosophy applied to generation). Returns a job handle immediately; provider runs are serialized behind the shared asset_generate limiter, visible through jobs.status/list, and cancellable through jobs.cancel. cutd DETECTS the CLI (codex = gpt-image; grok = grok-imagine; antigravity = agy image generation), spawns it in an isolated disposable run directory with a strict prompt to write the binary to an exact path, validates the result via the normal import probe, and publishes it immutably under assets/generated/<generation_id>.<ext> with a JSON provenance sidecar. Antigravity reuses its verified native sandbox/non-interactive CLI contract and keeps its normal login/settings in place; Cut never reads, copies, or rewrites provider auth/settings. Optional references are registered visual project asset IDs only (maximum four): cutd resolves, content-checks, and copies them into the isolated scratch workspace before the provider sees them, never accepting caller filesystem paths. family_id is content-addressed from provider/kind/model/prompt/reference content. The base generation_id remains backward-compatible with the original no-reference id; an explicit variation creates a distinct immutable take in the same family. Repeating the exact request reuses the unchanged project asset without running the provider CLI or consuming credits again. Different requests and variants never overwrite earlier generated sources. A job stays bound to the project open when submitted and fails on a project or reference change instead of importing against stale context. provider: 'codex' (image only) | 'grok' (image + video) | 'antigravity' (image only). HONEST degradation: empty prompt, invalid references, an unsupported kind, an unsupported Antigravity capability contract, or an absent/un-signed-in CLI fails with a reason (NEVER a fake asset). The spawn is bounded by timeout_ms and killed on timeout/drop/cancel; scratch files are removed before cancellation reports completion. Requires an open project. NOTE: this runs the user's generation CLI, which may incur provider cost / need sign-in; these CLIs do not report a price, so the completed job's result.generated.cost_usd is null with an honest cost_note.

prompt.description: What to generate (the description handed to the CLI).

provider.description: codex = gpt-image (image only); grok = grok-imagine (image + video); antigravity = agy (image only).

kind.description: Media kind (default image). Video needs provider:grok; Antigravity is image-only.

model.description: Optional model override passed to the CLI.

references.description: Optional registered project image/video asset ids to use as visual references. Caller paths are never accepted.

variation.description: Optional stable take label. Omit for the backward-compatible base take; a distinct value creates a new immutable variant in the same family.

track.description: Insert mode: target video track id.

at_ms.description: Insert mode: timeline position for the reserved slot.

duration_ms.description: Insert mode: reserved timeline slot duration.

target_clip.description: Replace mode: existing video media clip whose id, timing, and look stay intact.

placement.description: Optional timeline destination. Insert creates a local pending placeholder before queuing and replaces that same clip on success; failure or cancellation leaves the placeholder for an explicit retry. Replace generates against an existing video media clip and swaps it only after validated media is ready. Placement conflicts never discard successfully generated media.

timeout_ms.description: Generation timeout (defaults: Codex 240000, Grok 600000, Antigravity 660000; clamped 10s–30m).

verbs.result: queued handle {job_id,generation_id,family_id,provider,kind,variation,placement?,state:'queued'}; poll jobs.status. placement is path-light and identifies the reserved target clip. A done job result is the media-import result (asset_id, job_id, op, …) + generated:{schema,generation_id,family_id,provider,kind,model,prompt,variation,references,created_at_ms,reused,cost_usd:null,cost_note,provenance_path} + placement?:{mode,target_clip,track,duration_ms,state:'applied'|'failed',edit?,cleanup?,error?}. An unchanged repeated request completes with the existing asset_id and reused:true without a provider run. Provider/setup/validation errors end with outcome:failed; jobs.cancel keeps state:failed for compatibility but reports outcome:cancelled and outcome_reason:user_cancelled. An insert placeholder remains available for retry. A late placement failure does not turn provider success into generation failure or discard the imported asset.

verbs.name: assets.generated_list
verbs.description: List generated media registered in the OPEN project with path-light provenance and integrity state. Pure READ: scans only project assets whose source is a direct child of the canonical assets/generated directory, parses the sibling provenance sidecar, checks its generation id/content hash against the registered asset, and re-hashes the immutable media before reporting integrity:'verified'. Never returns source or provenance filesystem paths. Legacy generated-asset/1 sidecars remain readable; generated-asset/2 adds family, variation, references, and creation time.
verbs.result: {items:[{asset_id,generation_id,family_id,provider,kind,model,prompt,variation,reference_asset_ids,created_at_ms,cost_usd:null,cost_note,content_hash,provenance_schema,integrity}],total,verified}; integrity is verified | changed | offline | missing_provenance | invalid_provenance | provenance_mismatch | unsafe_source. Symlinked media/sidecars are never trusted or followed. No filesystem paths are returned.
